description: Search active auctions on shopgoodwill.com, the online auction site run by Goodwill member organizations, cameras, jewelry, watches, art, collectibles, electronics, clothing. Returns live listings with current bid price, bid count, buy-now price, category, end time and listing URL. Bids are served through a 5-minute result cache, so the current bid can be up to five minutes old: near the close of an auction treat it as a lower bound, never as the final price. Sourced from the shopgoodwill.com search API.

buy_now_only.description: Only listings with a Buy Now price

category_id.description: Optional ShopGoodwill category id to narrow results (e.g. 15 = Art, 99 = Books)

per_page.description: Max results to return, up to 40 (each source page holds 40 rows; use page to paginate)

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. "nikon d750" or "sterling silver"

name: shopgoodwill_search
title: Shopgoodwill Search
